div.div:
Crow's-foot notation. PK primary key, FK foreign key, UK unique key.
FK <name>: the foreign key references an entity that is not drawn here.
Dashed boxes belong to another diagram (key only).
UK*: partial unique index (unique only for rows matching its WHERE condition).
